meta.name: Guardrail Roadmap

swimlanes.label: Enterprise
swimlanes.description: Enterprise delivery items, rollout work, and capability gaps.

swimlanes.label: Runtime
swimlanes.description: Execution-path, lane, and model/runtime integration work.

swimlanes.label: Recipes
swimlanes.description: Recipe catalog expansion, packaging, and guardrailed operator surfaces.

swimlanes.label: Platform

meta.scratchpad: Tracker reconciled with docs/technical-status.md: completed P0/runtime/recipe slices are now recorded alongside the remaining enterprise and deferred backlog. D0za is now closed after live direct-turn and artifact/report proofs on the host Claude lane.

tasks.title: Claude interactive submit/complete contract
tasks.goal: Close the remaining long packet/file-pointer completion gap on the resident Claude interactive backend.

context.notes: Technical status item D0za. Closed after live host-runtime proof of both tiny direct turns and bounded artifact/report turns.

tasks.title: Versioned admin/event APIs and read-access auditing
tasks.goal: Finish the external API/admin compatibility side now that event schema v1 is frozen.

context.notes: Technical status item 36. P0e closed schema v1; versioned external/admin compatibility guarantees remain open.

tasks.title: Publish recipes through an npm registry package
tasks.goal: Add npm distribution for Guardrail recipes once the GitHub-based distribution path is proven stable.
tasks.blocker_reason: Deferred until the GitHub-based distribution path and registry ergonomics are proven.

tasks.title: Ship secret-mutation recipes
tasks.goal: Publish guarded secret-management recipes only once the product can support write-only secret input, runtime injection, revocation, and audit safely.
tasks.blocker_reason: Deferred until write-only secret-input UX, multi-stage approval, and guaranteed audit/log redaction are strong enough to ship secret-mutation recipes honestly.

tasks.title: Ship destructive cloud mutation recipes
tasks.goal: Publish destructive cloud-operation recipes only after Guardrail can bind resources/accounts, prove dry-run parity, and enforce strong multi-stage approval.
tasks.blocker_reason: Deferred until resource/account binding, destructive-change summaries, dry-run parity guarantees, and stronger multi-stage approval exist.

tasks.title: Universal authorization seam
tasks.goal: Ship one shared authorize(action, facts) boundary across all execution paths.

tasks.title: Policy simulation and decision traces
tasks.goal: Add dry-run policy evaluation and structured decision traces on top of the authorization seam.

tasks.title: Sovereign record metadata model
tasks.goal: Stamp hosted-facing records with organization/workspace, retention, payload hash, sensitivity, and provenance metadata.

tasks.title: Single crypto boundary
tasks.goal: Keep all sensitive-at-rest flows routed through one replaceable crypto boundary.

tasks.title: Event schema v1
tasks.goal: Freeze the event vocabulary and emit schema-versioned event families across all subsystems.

tasks.title: Model gateway seam
tasks.goal: Centralize model/wrapper dispatch behind one allowlisted gateway seam.

tasks.title: Pre-egress scrubbing and classification hooks
tasks.goal: Classify, block, or redact outgoing adapter payloads before they leave the trust boundary.

tasks.title: Emergency controls
tasks.goal: Add revocation, break-glass, and emergency kill-switch controls with audit coverage.

tasks.title: Guarded AI exec progress channel
tasks.goal: Provide real-time operator visibility and continuation for long-running one-shot AI packets.

tasks.title: True repo-local autonomous lane mode
tasks.goal: Keep lane state and downstream tool project/session state repo-local for hands-free execution.

tasks.title: Self-hosted recipe registry (JSON API)
tasks.goal: Ship a static export/import recipe registry path for enterprise and air-gapped use.

tasks.title: Ship-now bounded recipe batch
tasks.goal: Ship the initial bounded set of high-signal day-one recipes.

tasks.title: Broad package install recipes
tasks.goal: Ship bounded npm and pip install recipes for safer dependency bootstrap flows.

tasks.title: Direct push and history-mutation recipes
tasks.goal: Ship bounded Git push, amend, and safe force-push recipes.

tasks.title: Task-specific OpenClaw recipes
tasks.goal: Ship task-oriented OpenClaw entrypoints with hard-bound scope and verification.

tasks.title: Cloud audit log shipping and retention
tasks.goal: Add remote audit delivery and retention-backed enterprise log handling.

context.notes: Technical status item 15. Folded into enterprise items 28 and 36 in the broader roadmap.

tasks.title: HSM / KMS key management
tasks.goal: Add external key custody and governance beyond the local AES-256-GCM store.

context.notes: Technical status item 16. Local key management exists; external custody is still open.

tasks.title: SOC 2 Type II certification
tasks.goal: Reach the process and audit maturity needed for large enterprise contracts.

tasks.title: Org/workspace lifecycle, delegated admin, and service accounts
tasks.goal: Add governed org/workspace persistence and delegated admin/service account capabilities.

tasks.title: HA/DR, backups, restore, failover, and SLOs
tasks.goal: Add production-grade replicated state, backup/restore orchestration, failover, and ops telemetry.

tasks.title: Spend governance / FinOps / chargeback
tasks.goal: Add org/project quotas, provider cost ingestion, and chargeback-aware budget enforcement.

tasks.title: Private VPC / single-tenant / on-prem / regional deployment
tasks.goal: Support regulated buyer deployment control and topology choices.

tasks.title: BYOM / enterprise model endpoint control
tasks.goal: Add endpoint registry, credential injection, and policy-backed private model control.

tasks.title: Operational integrations
tasks.goal: Ship production connectors for SIEM, IdP, ticketing, SCM, webhooks, and public admin APIs.

tasks.title: Sovereign audit/event records and legal-hold metadata
tasks.goal: Add hosted control-plane persistence for legal-hold state, retention classes, and immutable records.

context.notes: Local seam landed via P0c; hosted persistence and legal-hold storage remain.

tasks.title: Enterprise crypto abstraction and external KMS/Vault custody
tasks.goal: Add external KMS/Vault/HSM integration and rotation orchestration on top of the local crypto boundary.

context.notes: Local seam landed via P0d; external custody and runtime brokering remain.

tasks.title: Tenant-scoped hosted control plane and noisy-neighbor isolation
tasks.goal: Add tenant-prefixed persistence, per-tenant queues, quotas, and hosted isolation boundaries.

tasks.title: Model gateway, model governance, and pre-egress scrubbing
tasks.goal: Add enterprise-grade provider allowlists, fallback/retention policy, token accounting, and governed egress.

context.notes: Local seams landed via P0f and P0g; hosted governance and policy control remain.

tasks.title: Event bus and enterprise integration spine
tasks.goal: Add a durable event bus, delivery guarantees, and production connectors around the frozen event vocabulary.

tasks.title: Break-glass controls, revocation, and emergency kill switch rollout
tasks.goal: Add org/workspace kill switches, break-glass approval flows, and auditable emergency override paths.

context.notes: Local seam landed via P0h; broader enterprise rollout paths remain.

tasks.title: Secret-handle UX, write-only inputs, and access audit
tasks.goal: Add write-only secret inputs, secret handles, runtime injection/revocation, and access audit trails.

tasks.title: Data classification, sensitivity labels, and egress labeling
tasks.goal: Add sensitivity labels and classification-aware egress/export policy across prompts, artifacts, and events.

tasks.title: Hosted state snapshots, replay, and migration tooling
tasks.goal: Add snapshot/rehydration, event replay, schema migration, and rollback-safe hosted upgrades.

tasks.title: Queue admission control and tenant fairness
tasks.goal: Add quotas, admission control, fair scheduling, and starvation prevention.

tasks.title: Policy rollout management and safe rollback
tasks.goal: Add versioned policy bundles, canaries, rollback, and impact analysis.

tasks.title: DSAR / subject-access / deletion workflows
tasks.goal: Add subject access export flows, deletion orchestration, hold exceptions, and hosted identity plumbing.

tasks.title: Supply-chain attestations, SBOMs, and provenance packs
tasks.goal: Add SBOM generation, artifact attestations, provenance bundles, and evidence-pack tooling.
